vya_text: gU0 - vamanAnantaraM virecanasya vihitatvAdvirecanamAha - snigdhasya pItasnehasya, svinnasya kRutasvedasya ||

dI0 - pUrvasnehapAnayuktasya svedayuktasya cetyarthaH | vAntasyeti vamanaM kRutvA | etena snehapAnAdInAmanantareNa virecanaM na kAryamityaBiprAyaH | tathAhi - ‘pittamatyulbaNIkRutya snehasvede kRute sati | vamane ca kRute pUrvamataH samyagvirecayet’ iti | vamanAntaramapi snigdhasvinnasyeti | yaduktaM - ‘karmaNAM vamanAdInAmantaraM tvantare punaH | snehasvedau prayu~jjIta saMSodhanamanantaram’ iti | snigdhasvinnamatra kimarthaM tat dRuShTAntena draDhayati | yathA ‘snehasvedAvakRutvA~agre yastu saMSodhanaM pibet | dAruSuShkamivAnAmaM dehastasya viSIryata’ iti ||

pada:
virecanaviShayamAha -
snigdhasvinnasya vAntasya dadyAtsamyag virecanam |

vya_text: gU0 - adhaHsrastaH patitaH, grahaNIM pittadhAriNIM kRutvA kaPa AcCAdayet | yadA kaPaH grahaNImAcCAdayet tadA kiM kuryAt ityAha - mandAgniM gauravaM ca kuryAt | pravAhikAtIsAraBedastAM janayet | adhasrastasya kaPasya pratIkAramAha - athavA pakShAntare | AmaM balAsaM kaPaM ca pAcanaiH SuNThyairaNDAdiBiH pAcayet | yadvA snehanairGRutadugdhAdiBiH snigdhasya sveditasya recanaM kAryamiti vidhiH tatrocyate | vamanAdvirecanaM kadA deyamityapekShAyAmatrAnuktamiti liKyate | tatra BedaH | samyakpravRutte vamane saptarAtre gate sati | susaMskRutaSarIrasya pradAtavyaM virecanaM’ | carake ca ‘vAtaM saMsRuShTaM punaH saMsnehitaM tathA | uShNaM laGu tryahaM BuktaiH ShoDaSe~ahni virecayet’ | ShoDaSadine yadvA pakShAntare pakShAdvireko vAntasyeti suSrutavacanam | asyArthaH vAtaMkRutaM samyagvamanaM ShaDahasaMsRuShTaM ShaDahetyuktavamanaM punastryahaM saMsnehitaM punastryahamuShNakRutasvedaM punastryahaM laGuBuktaM athainaM vAmitaM BUyaH snehasvedopapAditaM | SleShmakAle gate j~jAtvA koShThaM samyagvirecayet’ | vAgBaTe evaM liKitam | asyArthaH. athainaM puruShaM vAmitaM kRutavamanaM ShaDahAnantaraM snehasvedopapAditaM BUyaH punaH SleShmakAle dvAdaSadivase gate sati punastrayahaM laGu BaktaM ShoDaSe hyeva koShThaM samyagvirecayediti vAgBaTArthaH || 1 || 2 ||

dI0 - avAntasyetyAdi | adhaHsrastodhaH prAptaH recanadravyapraBAvavaSAt | etAdRuSaH kaPastadA grahaNImAcCAdayet | grahaNImagnisthitAnnasthAnaM | yaduktam - ‘agnyadhiShThAnamannasya grahaNAdgrahaNI mate’ti | ata evAdau vamanenAtra kaPanigraho vidheyaH | so~apyASrayasamASrayaNAtsroto~avarodhahetuH na kevalaM grahaNIcCAdanaM karoti | mandAgnimityAdi | atra gauravaM SarIrasyeti | pravAhikAtIsAraBedaH | atha kAryAntaramAha - pAcanairiti | pAcanadravyaiH sAmamityaparipakvarasaM || tathAhi - 'jaTharAnaladaurbalyAdavipakvastu yo rasaH | sa AmasaMj~jako dehe sarvadoShaprakopaka’ iti | na kevalamAmaM SrleShmANaM ca vipAcayet | etena kRutavamanasyApi pUrvaM pAcanaM dattvA paScAdvirecayedityaBiprAyaH | athaveti grahaNAttena vamanaM vinA pAcanaM deyamityarthaH | saMSodhanakrame~api pAcanasya prAdhAnyamuktaM | tathA tIsaTe coktaM - ‘prAk pAcanaM snehavidhirvidheyaH svedastataH syAdvamanaM virekaH | nirUhaNaM snehanabastikarma nasyaM kramaSceti BiShagvarANAm’ iti | eShAM kramABiprAyeNa vinApi virecanasya pUrvaM pAcanaM kartavyameveti vyavahAraH sa~ggata eva | atha pAcanamaBidhAya virecanamapi kasya kathaM dAtavyamityAha - snigdhasyeti | pUrvakRutasnigdhapAcanasya, kaiH snehanairGRutAdiBiH | na kevalaM snigdhasya recanaM kiMtu svedairapi svinnasya sveditasya virecanaM praSastaM | yadvA snehanaiH svedairiti saMbandhaH | snehasvedairityanena doShANAM suKamutpATanaM sUcitaM | yataH ‘snehasvedaiH pracalitA rasaiH snigdhairudIritAH | doShAH koShThagatA jantoH suKaM haMti virecanai’riti | pUrvamuktamapyadaH punareva draDhayati na doShaH paunaruktyena | kecidvakShyamANena SaradRutAviti Slokena militvA vyAKyAnayanti | tatra SaradRutau snigdhasya snehanaiH kRutvA virecanaM kAryaM | vasante ca svedaiH svinnameva recanaM deyaM | na tu snigdhasya iti na sarvamatam || 1 || 2 ||

pada:
vamane~apyakRute sati doShamAha - 
avAntasya tvadhaH srasto grahaNIM CAdayetkaPaH || 1 || 
mandAgniM gauravaM kuryAjjanayedvA pravAhikAm |
athavA pAcanairAmaM balAsaM ca vipAcayet || 2 || 
snigdhasya snehanaiH kAryaM svedaiH svinnasya recanam |

vya_text: gU0 - idAnIM virecanayogye virecanakAlamAha - SaradRutau ASvinakArtike tathA vasante caitravaiSAKe dehaSuddhau BiShagvirecayet | anyadA anyasminkAle vA satyapi rogotpattau budhaH SodhanaM SIlayet || 3 ||

dI0 - atra Suddhau cAsvasthasya SodhanAya SaradRutau vasante ca virecanaM deyaM | cakArAdvarShAsvapi | taduktam - ‘SItodBavaM doShacayaM vasante viSodhayan grIShmajamaBrakAle | GanAtyaye vArShikamASu samyak prApnoti rogAnRutujAnna jAtu’ iti | virecanamityanena viSeSheNa recanaM SaradAditriShveva | anyadA himaSiSiragrIShme kAle akArye tasmin virecanaM kRute sati pUrvaM paScAdvihitaSodhanaM SIlayedityaBiprAyaH | ata eva budha iti kAlaviSeShaj~jo doShaviSeShaj~jaSca || 3 ||

pada:
svamate tu -
virecanakAlamAha - 
SaradRutau vasante ca deyaM Suddhau virecanam || 3 || 
anyadAtyayike kArye svedanaM SIlayedbudhaH |

vya_text: gU0 - doShanASe SodhanotkRuShTamAha - sugamam ||4||

dI0 - laMGanamatropavAsaH, pAcanasya pRuthugupAdAnAt | saptasu SamaneShu dvayorgrahaNaM pradhAnatvAt | ye tu saMSodhanaiH SuddhA doShAsteShAM na punarudBavaH | ayamarthaH la~gGanAdayaH SamanatvAt saMcitAn doShAn mUlAn nonmUlayaMti kiMtu Samayanti te kadAcitsvalpahetunA~api kupyanti ye SodhanaiH SuddhAH teShAM punarudBavo na Bavati CinnasaMcayatvAt | uktaM ca suSrute - ‘sa~jcayopahRutA doShA laBante nottarA gatIH’ iti | bahupustakeShu ‘doShAH kadAcitkupyanti’ amuM SlokaM ‘pittaM virecanaM yu~jjyAt’ asyAgre paThanti tadasa~ggatameva SodhanaparataivAsya Slokasya pUrvaSlokaH | ‘SaratkAle vasante ca’ ityayaM Sodhanapara eva tena SodhanaPalArtha evAyaM SlokaH | tena - ‘SaratkAle vasante ca’ asya SlokasyAgre ‘doShAH kadAcitkupyanti ayaM SlokaH paThanIyaH | virecanasyA~api SodhanatvAdyathAkatha~jcitsamAdheyaM vA || 4 ||

pada:
SarIraSuddhau SodhanamuktaM tasya PalamAha -
doShAH kadAcitkupyanti jitA la~gGanapAcanaiH ||4|| 
ye tu saMSodhanaiH SuddhA na teShAM punarudBavaH |

vya_text: gU0 - yeShu rogeShu virecanaM dIyate tAnAha - pitte pittavikAre, AmodBUte AmavAtAdau | udare udararoge | AdhmAne koShThASuddhau baddhakoShThAdau || 5 ||

dI0 - atha virecanaM keShAM niyataM tAnAha - ‘pittavirecanamiti | pittajanitAnAmupadravANAM pittAtmakAnAM niyato vinASa iti kevalapitte~api virecanamaBihitam | tathAca tantrAntare~api -‘SarIrajAtAnAM doShANAM krameNa paramauShadhaM | bastirvireko vamanaM tathA tailaGRutaM madhviti’ | AmodBUte gade tatheti | AmajanitavyAdhau | AmavAtavikArAdAvityaryaH | udara iti udararogarUDhi:| AdhmAnodarApUraH | koShThASuddhAviti | koShThasya aSuddhiH baddhakoShTha iti prasiddhiH | viSeShata ityanenaivamAdInAmapareShAmapi virecanaM viSeSheNa kuryAdityarthaH | atha Sodhanasya prAdhAnyaviShayatvena virecanamuKyatvamAha - ayaM SlokaH SodhanapadagrahaNenAnyacCodhanaparo~api Bavati | atrAcAryeNa la~gGanapAcanairityuktena vamanaviShayasya niShedhaparatvAdvirecanAdhyAye svIkRutaH | nanu ye~api la~gGanapAcanairjitAste punaH kathaM saMBavanti ? ucyate | kadAcidatisvalpahetulABena jitA apyajitAH doShamUlAnucCedAt mUlaBUtASayagatadoShadUShyasamudBavAt samyagjitAH alpamapi hetuM prApya punaH kupyantIti BAvaH | tena teShAM punarudBava iti | saMSodhanena mUladoShajanyAdalpahetunA na kadApi prakopaH balavattarahetunA Bavatyeva || 5 ||

pada:
atha pittAdau virecanam |
pitte virecanaM yu~jjyAdAmodBUte gade tathA || 5 || 
udare ca#foot@ - cakArAt pittasaMyoge~api pittolbaNe yojyam - uktaMca vAgBaTe - ‘kaPe vidadhyAdvamanaM saMyAge vA kaPolbeNe | tadvadvirecanaM pitte’ iti |# tathA~adhmAne koShThaSuddhyai viSeShataH ||

vya_text: gU0 – avirecanayogyAnAha - ete bAlAdayo vijAnatA viSeShaj~japuruSheNa na virecyAH || 6 || 7 ||

dI0 - virecyA iti | viSeSheNa recyA na BavantItyaBiprAyeNAlparecanasyA prAptireva | ata eva bAlavRuddhayorapyayaM niShedhaH sAmAnyaH | viSeSheNa tu virekasAdhyavyAdhyupagrastayoH kiMciddeyamityuktaM | tathAca - ‘agnikShAravirekaistu bAlavRuddhau vivarjayet | tatsAdhyeShu vikAreShu mRudvIM kuryAt laGukriyAm’ iti | niShiddhAcaraNamanyatrApyuktam - ‘atyantapittAdviparItadehAn vireca- yettAnapi mandamandam’ iti | tAnapi niShiddhabAlavRuddhAdIn | atisnigdha ityatisnehapAnAdiyuktaH | tathAhi ‘navA~atisnigdhakAyasya dadyAtsnehavirecanaM | doShAH praBAvitA BUyo lIyante tena vartmasu’ iti | kShatakShINA iti | dhAtuSoShaNatvena SoShI kathitaH | sa ca rAjayakShmaBedaH | BayAnvito BayayuktaH | BayagrahaNatvena SokABitaptasya dInasya vA niShedho darSitaH | yaduktaM ‘kShINastathA rUkShitabAlavRuddhadIno~atha SoShI BayaSokataptaH’ ityAdi | sthUlo bahumedonvitaH | mandAgnirapi kaPolbaNatvAt | rUkSho vAtolbaNa iti | athavA rUkSha ityasnigdhaH | tathAhyuktaM ‘virUkShaM snehasAtmyaM tu BUyaH saMsnihya recaye’diti | vijAnatetyanena virecanaviShayavikalpaviSeShaj~jena vaidyenetyarthaH | yataH ‘virecanairyAnti narA vinASamaj~japrayuktairavirecanIyA’ iti || 6 || 7 ||

pada:
idAnIM ye virecane niShiddhAstAnAha -
bAlavRuddhAvatisnigdhaH kShatakShINo BayAnvitaH || 6 || 
SrAntastRuShArtaH sthUlaSca garBiNI ca navajvarI |
navaprasUtA nArI ca mandAgniSca madAtyayI || 7 || 
SalyArditaSca rUkShaSca na virecyA vijAnatA |

vya_text: gU0 - jIrNajvarI cirajvarI, garavyApto viShayukta:, udaram udararogiNaM, granthirogaH | nanUdaraM pUrvamuktamatrApyucyate tatkathaM na punaruktiH ? ucyate - udare punaruktirvirecanArthaM | yadvA udaragranthirBinnarogaH | spaShTamanyat || 8-11 ||

dI0 - virekasAdhyAn rogAnAha - jIrNajvarAdayo virekArhAH narA matAH | AcAryANAmiti SeShaH | jIrNajvarIti purANajvarI tasya virekasAdhyatvAt | garavyApta iti garaM kRutrimaM viShaM tena vyAptaH duHKitaH | tathA~arSAdipIDitAH | tathA yonirogAdiBirarditAH | tathA vidradhyAdiyutAH | tathA karNanAsASirovakragudameDhrAmayAnvitA iti | karNAdijanitAmayAnvitA ityarthaH | tenAmayaSabdo karNAdiBiH saha saMbadhyate | plIhaSothAkShirogArtA iti plIhAdirogavyAptA ityarthaH | krimikShINAnilArditA iti | kRumyAdiBirarditAH pIDitAH | virekArhA iti virecanayogyA ityarthaH || 8-11 ||

pada:
virecanayogyAnAha -
jIrNajvarI garavyApto vAtaraktI BagandarI || 8 || 
arSaH pANDUdaragranthihRudrogArucipIDitAH |
yonirogapramehArtA gulmaplIhavraNArditAH || 9 || 
vidradhicCardivisPoTavisUcIkuShThasaMyutAH |
karNanAsASirovakragudameDhrAmayAnvitAH || 10 || 
pa#094D;lIhaSothAkShirogArtA: krimikShINAnilArditA: | 
SUlino mUtraGAtArtA virekArhA narA matAH || 11 ||

vya_text: dI0 - bahupittaH koShThaH mRuduH, bahukaPo madhyaH, bahuvAtaH krUraH | madhyamena Sodhanena hInayogI krUraH | atiyogI mRuduH, samyagyogI madhyaH | saMsargasannipAtajakoShThe yogavAhitvaM kaPasya j~jeyaM vacanabalAt | yadAha KAraNAdiH - ‘vAtolbaNA syAdBahaNI krUrakoShThasya dehinaH | pittalA mRudukoShThasya yogavAhI tayoH kaPaH’ iti | tena vAtakaPAByAM krUraH, madhyo vAtapittAByAM, sannipAtAcca mRuduH | nanu bahuvAtaSleShmaByAM krUraH, iti suSrutena bahukaPasya krUratvamuktam | iha tu madhyamatvamiti virodhaH ? maivaM - suSrutavAkyasya saMsargaparatvAditi bopadevapaNDitAH | durvirecya iti kRucCrAtsAmAdiko~apyavirecyaH || 12 ||

pada:
atha virecanaj~jAnArthaM koShThaBedAnAha - 
bahupitto mRuduH koShTho jahuSleShmA ca madhyamaH |
bahuvAtaH krUrakoShTho durvirecya: sa kathyate || 12 ||

vya_text: gU0 - virecane mRudumadhyakrUrakoShThamAha - mRudviti | mRudumadhyamatIkShNakairdravyairmRudvImAtrAdayo matAH| sugamam ||13||

dI0 - mRudvAdidravyaiH mRudvAdikoShThakeShu mRudvAdimAtrA matA, AcAryANAmiti SeShaH | nanu mRudurdravyairmRudvAdyA mAtrA Bavati kimarthaM mRudvAdimAtretItyAdi ? ucyate -hInayogAtiyogasamyagyogAya, te ca vaidyAdhInAH | uktaM ca - ‘alpasyApi mahArthatvaM praBUtasyAlpakarmatAm | kuryAt saMSleShaviSleShakAlasaMskArayuktitaH’ ityAdi mAtrAj~jAnArthamuktam || 13 ||

pada:
koShThAnurUpAM mAtrAmAha -
mRudvI mAtrA mRudukoShThe madhyakoShThe ca madhyamA |
krUre tIkShNA matA dravyairmRudumadhyamatIkShNakaiH ||13||

vya_text: gU0 - tAni dravyANyevAha - payo dugdham, tailaiH eraNDAditailaiH, trivRutA niHsRutA, tiktA kaTukI, rAjavRukSho girimAlakaH, snuk sehuNDaH tasya dugdham, hemakShIrI svarNakShIrI dantI jayapAlaH | AdiSabdAt indravAruNIbrahmalavaNyAdayaH || 14 ||

dI0 - mRuduriti | mRuduH koShThaH drAkShAdiBiH samyak viricyate | tatra drAkShA gostanI, payaH godugdham uShNAmbu uShNodakam, pAnIyatvena madhyame~api grahaNam | athavAmbuSabdaH sArakamastvAdidravopalakShaNaH, tailamairaNDatailam | madhyastu madhyakoShThaH na krUro na mRuduriti madhyapadABidhAnAt | sa ca trivRutAdiBiH samyak viricyate | trivRutA SyAmA, tiktA kaTukI, rAjavRukSho girimAlakaH| krUra iti | krUrakoShThaH snukpayohemakShIryAdiBirviricyate | snuk sehuNDaH, hemakShIrI svarNakShIrI, dantIPalaM jayapAlaH | AdigrahaNAt kumBAtilvakAdayaH || 14 ||

pada:
mRudvAdidravyANi kAni tAni ityata Aha -
mRudurdrAkShApayaScAmbutailairapi viricyate | 
madhyamastrivRutAtiktArAjavRukShairviricyate || 14 ||
krUraH snukpayasAhemakShIrIdantIPalAdiBiH |

vya_text: gU0 - uttamAdiBedena virekapramANamAha - mAtrottameti | sugamam || 15 ||

dI0 - mAtrottameti | pravarA vegamAtrA triMSadvegairj~jaiyA, tathA kaPAntageti kaili~ggakaM mAnam | tathA viMSatiBirvegairmadhyA, tathA daSaBirvegairhInA | uktaMca vAgBaTe - ‘jaGanyamadhyapravare tu vegAScatvAra iShTA vamane ShaDaShTau | daSaiva te dvitriguNA vireke prasthastathA SoNitamokShaNe ca’ iti | tulAmAnamapyuktaM tenaiva - ‘prasthastathA syAddvicaturguNaSca | dvitrAnsaviTkAnapanIya vegAnmeyaM vireke vamane tu pItam’ iti | keciduttamasya vAyoH krUrakoShTasya ca uttamA mAtrA tIkShNA~aBimatA, ata eva kaPAntagAnmeyaM vireke vamane tu pItamiti, madhyamA~api tasya mRudukoShThasya hInA iti vyAKyAnayanti || 15 ||

pada:
virekasyottamAdimAtrAyai vA~ggakaili~ggakaparimANamAha -
mAtrottamA virekasya triMSadvegaiH kaPAntagA || 15|| 
vegairviMSatiBirmadhyA hInoktA daSavegakaiH |

vya_text: gU0 - vireke kaShAyAdInAM mAtrAkathanam - virecanaM dvipalaM SreShTham, palaM madhyamaM, palArdhaM kanIyaH svalpam | kaShAyAnantaraM virecane kalkAdInAM pramANamAha - madhvAjyalehataH karShadvayaM trayaM vA~api deyam | vayorogAdyapekShA vicAraNIyam || 16 || 17 ||

dI0-kaShAyANAmiti | kaShAyaSabdena rasaH SRutaH SItaPANTAnAM caturNAM grahaNaM kalkasya pRuthagupAdAnAt | dvipalaM SreShThamityanena vAtajanitakoShThasyetyarthaH | virecanaM SreShThaM mAnaM kaShAyANAmuttamA mAtretyarthaH | palaM madhyamaM madhyamA mAtrA pittajanitamRudukoShThasyetyarthaH | ardhapalaM kanIyo mAtrA hInA mAtretyarthaH | kaPena madhyamakoShThaH kathitaH | kalkamodakacUrNAnAmiti | kalkAdInAM karShaM madhvAjyayogataH virecanam | vA athavA vayorogAdyapekShayA karShadvayaM palaM vA virecanam | madhuGRutamAnaM viShamatayA yojyam | uktaM ca - ‘Bajato viSharUpatvaM tulyAMSau madhusarpiShI’ iti | AdigrahaNAtkoShThAdi j~jAtvA virecanaM deyam || 16 || 17 ||

pada:
idAnIM kaShAyaguTikAcUrNAtmakAnAM virecanadravyANAM parimANamAha -
dvipalaM SreShThamAKyAtaM madhyamaM ca palaM Bavet || 16|| 
palArdhaM ca kaShAyANAM kanIyastu virecanam |
kalkamodakacUrNAnAM karShaM madhvAjyalehataH || 17 || 
karShadvayaM palaM vA~api vayorogAdyapekShayA |

vya_text: gU0 - trivRutAdivirecanaM kathaM pibet ? ityAha - pittottare pittAdhikye trivRuccUrNaM drAkShAkkAthAdiBi: pibet | kaPArditaH triPalAkkAthaM gomUtraiH pItvA trikaTukaM pibet | vAtArditaH vAtapIDitaH trivRutsaindhavaSuNThInAM cUrNamamlairnimbAdiBiH pibet | jA~ggalAnAM jA~ggalamAMsAnAM vA rasena iti pakShAntare || 18 || 19 ||

dI0 - pitte virecanasya prAdhAnyaKyApanArthaM prAk | pittottaragrahaNam | pittottare koShThe drAkShAkvAthAdiBiH trivRuccUrNaM pibet | AdigrahaNAt kShIrekShukASmaryasvAduskandavarArasAdiBiH | kaPArditaH triPalAkvAthagomUtraiH vyoShaM trikaTukaM trivRuccUrNaM ca pibet| atrApi virekAyeti saMbandhaH | vAtArditaH trivRutSuNThIsaindhavAnAM cUrNamamlairmadyakA~jjikabIjapUrarasAdiBiH athavA jA~ggalAnAM rasairhariNaiNatittiralAvAdInAM rasairmAMsarasairvirecanaM pibet | vAgBaTe tu - ‘atha kAle tu taccUrNaM kiMcinnAgarasaindhavam | vAtAmaye pibedamlaiH pitte sAjyasitAmadhu | kShIradrAkShekShukASmaryasvAduskandhavarArasaiH | kaPAmaye pIlurasamUtramadyAmlakA~jjikaiH | pa~jcakolAdicUrNaiSca yuktyA yuktaM kaPApahaiH | trivRutkalkakaShAyeNa sAdhitaH sasito himaH | madhu trijAtasaMyukto leho hRudyaM virecanam | ajagandhA tavakShIrI vidArI SarkarA trivRut | cUrNitaM madhusarpirByAM lIDhvA sAdhu viricyate | sannipAtajvarastamBapipAsAdAhapIDitaH | tvagelAByAM samA nIlI taistrivRuttaiSca SarkarA | cUrNaM PalarasakShaudrasaktuBistarpaNaM pibet | vAtapittakaPottheShu rogeShvalpAnaleShvapi | nareShu sukumAreShu nirapAyaM virecanam’ || iti | cakradatte tu - ‘BittvA dvidhekShu parilipya kalkaistriBaNDijAtaiH pariveShTya rajjvA | pakvaM tu samyak puTapAkayuktyA KAdettu taM pittagadI suSItam’ iti || 18 || 19 ||

pada:
trivRutAcUrNam |
atha vAtAdInAM koShThamAtrAdiBedena katipayayogAn darSayannAha -
pittottare trivRuccUrNaM drAkShAkkAthAdiBiH pibet ||18|| 
triPalAkkAthagomUtraiH pibedvyoShaM kaPArditaH | 
trivRutsaindhavaSuNThInAM cUrNamamlaiH pibennaraH || 19 || 
vAtArdito virekAya jA~ggalAnAM rasena vA |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM ShaDRutuvirekaviShayatvena tadyogAnurUpAnyogAnAha - trivRuteti | trivRutAdiBirvarShAkAle prAvRuShi virecanaM tatra doShasa~jcayAt | trivRut SyAmA, kauTajaM bIjaM indrayavA:, pippalI mAgadhI, viSvaBeShajaM SuNThI, drAkShA gostanI, tasyA rasaH, kShaudraM madhu iti | varShAgrahaNena prAvRuTgrahaNaM doShopacayaprakopanimittAt | GanAtyaye SaratkAle yogamAha - trivRuddurAlaBetyAdi | trivRut SyAmA, durAlaBA samudrAntA tasyA alABe yavAsakaH, mustA BadramustA, SarkarA sitopalA, udIcyaM vAlakaM, candanaM SvetacandanaM cUrNayogyatvAt | drAkShAmbunA gostanIkvAthena rasena vA | sayaShTyAhvaM yaShTImadhusahitaM, SItalaM SItaguNaM SItasparSaM ca tena pittaGnatvamasya yogasya kathitam | ata eva SaratkAle yogyatA~asya yogasya iti | SiSire vasante ca virecanamAha - pippalI nAgaramiti | pippalI kaNA, nAgaraM SuNThI, saindhavam, SyAmA SyAmamUlA, trivRut mAlavikAKyA aruNamUlA ca | uktaM ca - ‘vidyAddvidhA ca tanmUlaM SyAmaM SyAmAruNaM trivRut’ iti | SiSiragrahaNena hemantasyA~api grahaNam | vAgBaTe tu - ‘trivRutAM#foot@ -bahuShu pustakeShu mUlapAThe nAyaM SlokaH paThitaH |# citrakaM pAThAm ajAjIsaralaM vacAm | svarNakShIrIM ca hemante cUrNamuShNAmbunA pibet’ iti | grIShme virecanamAha - tulyA SarkarA grIShmakAle grIShmAKye kAle virecanaM deyam | anyat sugamam | atra kecitsarvartukaM yogaM paThanti || 21-24 ||

ShaDRutuvirecanam |

vya_text: gU0 - varShAkAle virecanavidhAnamAha - trivRutAniHsRutA, kauTajaM bIjam indrayavAH, viSvaBeShajaM SuNThI, mRudvIkA drAkShA tadrasaM, kShaudraM madhu, varShAkAle idaM virecanam | SaradvirecanamAha -trivRut niHsRutA, durAlaBA yavAsA, SarkarA sitA, candanaM Svetam, udIcyaM vAlakam, yaShTayAhvaM madhuyaShTI | etaddrAkShAmbunA drAkShAjalena GanAtyaye Saradvirecanam | atha hemantavirecanam - sindhu saindhavam, SyAmA vRuddhadArakaH trivRut niHsRutA | grIShme virecanam - sugamamanyat || 25 ||

dI0 - SItajalairiti | virekauShadhaklamanASArthaM SItalajalena netrasecanam | tathA sugandhaM mRugamadasuraBi uttamacandanAdInyAGrAya paScAdvaraM SreShThajIrNatAmbUlIpatrakRutaM SIlayet | nivAtastha iti vegapravRuttyarthaM vegAMSca na dhArayet, UrdhvavAtAdirogotpAdakatvAt | sva#093E;pena virekauShadhaSaktihAniH syAt | SItAmbu ityAdi | SItalodakaM kvApi pAnAdau na spRuSet | rekastamBakatvAt | ata evAha - koShNanIraM pibenmuhuriti | vAraM vAraM koShNaM jalaM peyaM rekaikakaraNArthamityarthaH ||34||35||

vya_text: gU0 - virekAt kiM niHsaratItyAha - vAnte sati yathA balAsauShadhapittAni vAyuH vrajet tathA raikAtkaPaH malaM pittaM BeShajaM ca gamayet balAsaH kaPam, auShadhaM BakShitaM malaM purISham ||36||

dI0 - yathA vamane prathamaM balAsaH kaPaH pravartate | paScAdvamanadravyaM nirgacCet | tadanu pittAni | bahuvacanatvena haritapItAni kaTutittaprAyANIti | tatpaScAdvAyuriti | tathA evamapi virekAtprathamaM malaM purIShaM tadanu pittaM tatpaScAdvirecanaM dravyaM | tadanu kaPaH pravartata iti | tena kaPAnte ca virecanamiti vacanAt | etena samyagvA~asamyagviriktaSca kathita ityaBiprAyaH | anyathA durvAnto durvirikta iti | tena durvAntalakShaNamanAdhyAye~aBihitaM durviriktalakShaNamatraivAgre vakShyati | nABeriti ShaShThaM vadanti kecit | tatra nABereva srastatvam ||36||

dI0 - durviriktasya na samyagviriktasya narasya nABeH stabdhatvAdayo jAyante | nABeriti | nABeH nAByupalakShitasya pradeSasya pakvASayAKyasya stabdhatvaM stabdhatA, tathA kukShiSUlatA kukShyoH SUlaM | purIShavAtasa~ggaSceti malavAtayoH sa~ggo rodhaH | tathA kaNDUmaNDalagauravamiti kaNDUH SarIre, maNDalaSabdenAtra varaTIdaMSasadRuSaM gauravaM SarIrodarayoH | vidAhaH pittavaddAhaH | arucirarocakaH | AdhmAnamudarApUraH | BramaScakrArUDhasyeva vastudarSanam | vAntiH CardiSceti | iti durviriktasya lakShaNam ||37||

dI0 - virekasyAtiyogena mUrcCAdayo Bavanti | gudasya BraMSa iti | gudasya bahirnirgamanaM, taccAtisaMpravAhaNAdBavati | uktaMca - ‘pravAhikA~atisArAByAM nirgacCati gudo bahi:’ iti | SUlaM nAnAprakArakamatra j~jeyam | tena parikartikA~apyatra Bavati | kaPAtiyogaH syAt kaPasya atisaraNaM Bavati | ‘tathA mAMsadhAvanasaMniBAdikaM viricyate mAMsadhAvanodakatulyaM, medoniBaM medaHsadRuSam | jalABAsamiti | jalasadRuSaM svacCamityarthaH | raktaM vA~api viricyata iti raktameva vA viricyate | anye mAMsadhAvanAdIni cAsya viSeShaNAni manyante niShpurIShatvAt | iti virekAtiyogalakShaNam || 39 || 40 ||

vya_text: gU0 - ativiriktopadrave pratIkAramAha - tasya SItAmbuBiH SItajalai: SarIraM siktaM sevitaM kuryAt | tathA madhumiSraistaNDulAmbuBirmRudu vamanaM kArayet | pratIkArAntaramAha - sahakAraH AmraH tasya tvacaH dadhnA sauvIraM kA~jjikaM tena piShTvA lepayet | sa lepaH ulvaNamatIsAraM hanti | atirekagrahaNArthaM pathyamAha - SIteH saMgrAhiBirdravyaiH saMgrahaNaM BiShak kuryAt, ajAkShIraM pAyayet tathA hAriNaM hariNamAMsajaM rasaM vaiShkiraM kukkuTANDaM mAMsarasaM vA ShaShTikaiH SAliBirmasUrairvA Bojayet | svalpaM tucCam | tathA SuNThyAdiBiH SItairdravyairdADimAdyairBiShak saMgrahaNaM kuryAt || 41-43 ||

dI0 - tasya vamanaM mRudu kArayet | tasya virekArditasya vamanaM mRudu kArayet | kiM kRutvA ? SItAmbuBiH SItajalaiH SarIraM siktvA si~jcayitvA | taNDulAmbuBiriti | taNDuladhAvanodakaiH | madhumiSrairiti | taNDuladhAvanairmadhumiSrairityarthaH | SItairiti | SItavIryadravyairlepamAha - sahakAratvaca ityAdi | sahakAra AmraH tasya tvacaH kalkaH dadhnA sauvIrakeNa kA~jjikaBedena peShayitvA nABipralepena ulbaNamatIsAraM hanyAt | BojanamAha - ajAkShIramityAdi | kShIrAdikaM raktaSAliBiH ShaShTikairvA saha Bojayet | kShIrasya kevalasyA~api pAnamAhureke saMgrAhakatvAt | rasaM mAMsarasaM, vaiShkiraM hAriNaM vA | viShkirA lAvatittirAdayaH | SAliBiriti raktaSAlyAdiBiH | ShaShTikairiti prasiddhaiH | svalpamityanena BRuShTataNDulaBavaM SAktukamapi deyaM | masUrairapi svalpaM BojanaM deyam | svalpamajIrNaBayAt | athavA SItaiH SItavIryairdravyaiH saMgrahaNaM kuryAt iti || 41-43 ||

vya_text: gU0 - idAnIM suviriktalakShaNamAha - dehasya lAGave sati manaH saMtuShTyAM satyAm anile vAyau anulomaM gate svamArge prApte sati lakShaNairnaraM suviriktaM j~jAtvA niSi pAcanaM eraNDaSuNThIdhAnyajaM pAyayet || 44 ||

dI0 - lAGavaM SarIrasyeti | manasastuShTiriti | cittasaMtoShaH | anile vAyau anulomam adhoBAgaM gate sati etAdRuSalakShaNena suviriktaM naraM jAnIyAt | evaM j~jAtvA tasyA~api pAcanaM niSi dadyAt | pAcanamaSeShasyAtra boddhavyaM | tacca mudgayUShAdikamityeke | yaduktaM ‘virecanAnAM sarveShAM dadhyannaM stamBane hitam | AmAnte ca pradAtavyamanyathA mudgamUShaka’miti | kecittu pAcanaM pAyayenniSItipadaM vinA paThanti na tu samyagviriktasyAyameva kramaH | yathAprAptiSca viTpittakaPAnilA na samyagviriktasya BaveyuH krameNeti | na caivaM kaPAntapadavyAGAtaH | tena pAcanapAdaH keShAMcinmanoharaM | yato vAyurhi niHSeShaM kaPe kRute AmASaye SUnyatayA kevalaH saratIti | yadvA AcAryeNa padapUraNArthaM liKitam | tenAsyA~anyo~aBiprAyaH | pAcanaM rAtrAvevetyarthaH || 44||
